title: Team Java game project with encouraged AI-tool use
summary: Teams of about seven students develop a networked multiplayer 3D Java game through preparation, analysis, design, coding, and testing phases. General-purpose AI tools are encouraged for selected tasks such as coding, documentation, and proofreading, while supervisors approve each milestone and the final product.

sources.title: Generative AI in Student Software Development Projects: A User Study on Experiences and Self-Assessment
sources.evidence_quote: about seven students work together in a team to create a computer game using a structured development process

purpose_and_stakes.pass_requirement: Supervisor approval of the final product and successful final team presentation.

assessment.summary: Design, implement, test, document, and present a complete networked multiplayer 3D Java game as a team.
student_actions: Extend a supplied Battleship training project.
Produce requirements, use cases, diagrams, tests, and a user manual.
Implement and test a Java game.
Use and critically oversee AI tools where useful.
Present the game publicly and to the supervisor.

inputs.description: Assigned one-page game proposal and Battleship blueprint

student_role.description: Freely available AI tools were encouraged, especially for coding, code documentation, and proofreading, but were not formally integrated into the curriculum.

grading.method: Pass-credit decision based on supervisor approval and presentations; no differentiated grade was awarded.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
